description: Embeds one static SVG image (staticFile, defaults to svg/Bitcoin.svg), optionally applies an SVG-native shader (tone/blur/tint/glow/metallic-texture/shine-sweep via styleOverride.shader — literal values, no tokens), and self-draws an animated dashed/dotted boundary line around its measured bounds using the shared assets/_shared/boundaryDrawer.jsx component.

src.description: path relative to public/ (or an http(s) URL) of the SVG image to render. Defaults to svg/Bitcoin.svg.

showBoundary.description: toggle the self-drawing dashed boundary line around the measured image (default true)

boundaryStrokeColorToken.description: color token (or raw hex) for the dashed boundary line

boundaryDashArray.description: dash length in SVG user units

boundaryDashGap.description: gap length in SVG user units

boundaryInset.description: px gap between the measured image edge and the drawn boundary line

boundaryDrawDurationFraction.description: fraction of the asset's active window spent drawing the boundary in

boundaryDelayFrames.description: absolute frames after the image's own enterAtFrame before the boundary starts drawing (image lands first, then the outline traces in). Overrides boundaryDelayFraction when set.

boundaryDelayFraction.description: fraction of the asset's active window to wait after the image enters before the boundary starts drawing (default 0.15). Ignored when boundaryDelayFrames is set.

boundaryRotate.description: keep the dash pattern crawling (marching ants) once fully drawn

shader.description: Optional SVG-native shader (assets/_shared/svgShader.jsx) — literal values only, NOT style-registry tokens. Absent/empty = no-op (byte-identical to no shader). Author by hand or via a curated preset, e.g. { "$alias": "shader.goldTint" } (see scripts/cli.js alias / studio/library/aliases/*.json, category 'shader').

contrast.description: literal multiplier pivoting around mid-gray, 1 = identity.

tintFill.description: literal raw hex (e.g. "#D4AF37") multiply-blended over the image. Named *Fill (not *Color) so it is never mistaken for a style-registry token. Absent = no tint.

tintStrength.description: literal 0-1 opacity of the tint flood before blending. Default 0.35.

glowFill.description: literal raw hex glow color, painted as a blurred copy of the image's traced alpha silhouette (real pixel shape, not a rectangular drop-shadow) behind the image. Absent = no glow.

glowStrength.description: literal px, glow feGaussianBlur stdDeviation. Default 12.

metallicStrength.description: literal 0+ intensity of a STATIC brushed-metal/foil specular-lighting texture (feTurbulence bump map + feSpecularLighting), masked to the image's own alpha and added on top. 0 (default) = off. Does not animate — see shineFill for a moving highlight.

metallicLightFill.description: literal raw hex color of the simulated light catching the metallic bump texture. Default "#FFFFFF".

metallicSurfaceScale.description: literal feSpecularLighting surfaceScale — height of the simulated bump ridges. Default 2.

metallicSpecularConstant.description: literal feSpecularLighting specularConstant — overall specular brightness multiplier. Default 1.

metallicAzimuth.description: literal degrees, feDistantLight azimuth (light direction in the image plane). Default 235.

metallicElevation.description: literal degrees, feDistantLight elevation (light height above the image plane). Default 40.

metallicFrequency.description: literal feTurbulence baseFrequency — grain size of the bump texture; smaller = coarser brushed-metal streaks, larger = finer grain. Default 0.015.

shineFill.description: literal raw hex color of an ANIMATED diagonal highlight band that sweeps across the image's traced silhouette once (light-catching-a-moving-surface shimmer). Absent = no sweep rendered. Distinct from the static metallic* texture above.

shineWidth.description: literal px width of the sweeping highlight band. Default 40.

shineAngleDeg.description: literal degrees, sweep direction off horizontal. Default 25.

shineOpacity.description: literal 0-1 peak opacity of the sweep band. Default 0.55.

shineLoop.description: when true the sweep repeats continuously at shinePeriodFrames cadence instead of a single pass timed to the asset's active window. Default false (one pass).

shinePeriodFrames.description: literal frames between sweeps when shineLoop is true. Default 60.
